sentences.text: At the very outset, learned A.G.A. has raised a preliminary objection regarding maintainability of present applicant.

He submits that since order impugned in present application is final order,
therefore, same is revisable in terms of Section 397/401 Cr.P.C.
In view of above, remedy lies to applicant by filing criminal revision.

As such, present application is not maintainable and is liable to Rakesh Kumar vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 17 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/174002915/
